title: Forex Plus Card - definition of Bank
text: 'Bank' refers to HDFC Bank Limited, a banking company incorporated in India under the Companies Act, 1956 and having its Registered Office at HDFC Bank House, Senapati Bapat Marg, Lower Parel, Mumbai - 400 013, India and includes its successors and assigns.

title: Forex Plus Card - definition of Card
text: 'Card' refers to HDFC Bank ForexPlus Card, issued to the customer by HDFC Bank in association with VISA/Mastercard.

title: Forex Plus Card - definition of Cardholder
text: 'Cardholder' refers to a customer of the Bank authorised to use the card.

title: Forex Plus Card - definition of EDC Terminal
text: 'EDC Terminal' shall mean Point-of-Sale electronic data capture capable of handling card transactions i.e., Electronic Draft Capture (EDC) terminal, printers, other peripherals and accessories, including ATM PIN (defined hereunder), pads and necessary software to run the devices and which processes the transaction at the Merchant Establishments abroad (except India, Nepal and Bhutan).

title: Forex Plus Card - definition of International Transactions
text: 'International Transactions' refer to the transactions entered into by the Cardholder on the card outside India, Nepal and Bhutan.

title: Forex Plus Card - definition of Merchant
text: 'Merchant' means any entity that owns or manages or operates Merchant Establishment.

title: Forex Plus Card - definition of Merchant Establishments
text: 'Merchant Establishments' shall mean establishments or facility, wherever located or registered, which honours the Card and shall include among others, stores, shops, restaurants, hotels, airline organisations, e-commerce websites, advertised as honouring the Visa/MasterCard.

title: Forex Plus Card - definition of Terms
text: 'Terms' refer to Terms and Conditions for use of the card as specified in this document.

title: Forex Plus Card - definition of Transactions
text: 'Transactions' mean any instruction given by a Cardholder using a card directly or indirectly to the Bank to effect a transaction.

title: Forex Plus Card - definition of VISA
text: VISA shall mean mark owned by VISA International.

title: Forex Plus Card - definition of MasterCard
text: MasterCard shall mean mark owned by MasterCard Incorporated or MasterCard Worldwide.

title: Forex Plus Card - definition of VISA/PLUS/MasterCard ATM network
text: 'VISA/PLUS/MasterCard ATM network' shall mean ATMs, wherever located, which honour the VISA/MasterCard and display the VISA/PLUS/MasterCard symbols.

title: Forex Plus Card - gender reference inclusivity
text: In the document, all references to the Cardholder being referred in masculine gender will also include the feminine/transgender gender.

title: Forex Plus Card - definition of Transaction
text: Transaction: Transaction includes cash withdrawals, payment for purchases made/services availed at Merchant Establishments, availing other services by utilising the card at ATMs and/or Merchant Establishments.

title: Forex Plus Card - definition of Personal Identification Number (PIN)
text: Personal Identification Number (PIN): The Bank will allot to the Cardholder a PIN to be used for cash withdrawals and balance enquiry at ATMs & IPIN for logging to PrepaidCard NetBanking. The Cardholder shall be entitled, using the PrepaidCard NetBanking portal, in accordance with the provisions herein, to change the ATM PIN. The Cardholder shall be responsible to maintain the confidentiality of the ATM PIN/IPIN. The Bank bears no liability for unauthorized use of the card.

title: Forex Plus Card - eligibility and application
text: Any individual (residing in India) may apply for the issuance of the ForexPlus Card through any branch, online digital channels, representative of the Bank or select money changers in India as determined by the bank, from time to time.

title: Forex Plus Card - application form and documentation requirements
text: The applicant for the Card will be required to complete and submit a duly signed application form, and further submit all such documents as may be necessary or required by the Bank from time to time.

title: Forex Plus Card - card property and non-transferability
text: The Card, as may be issued by the Bank to an applicant, shall remain the property of the Bank and shall not be transferable and will be honoured at Merchant Establishments only when the Card bears the signature of the Cardholder on the reverse and upon presentment at a Merchant Establishment by the Cardholder.

title: Forex Plus Card - compliance with applicable laws for issuance
text: The issuance of the Card is subject to compliance by the card applicant of the provisions of applicable laws (including Foreign Exchange Management Act, 1999), rules, regulations and directions as issued by the Reserve Bank of India, Prevention of Money-Laundering Act, 2002 and under any other law in force from time to time.

title: Forex Plus Card - applicability of rules and regulations
text: The issuance and use of the ForexPlus Card is subject to compliance by the Cardholder of the provisions of applicable laws (including the Foreign Exchange Management Act, 1999), rules, regulations and directions as issued by the Reserve Bank of India or other appropriate authority under any law in force from time to time.

title: Forex Plus Card - exchange control and anti-money laundering compliance
text: Utilization of the ForexPlus Card shall be in strict accordance with the exchange control Regulations of the RBI and Prevention of Money-Laundering Act, 2002. In the event of non-compliance by Cardholder with same, the Bank shall be entitled, either at its discretion, or at the instance of the RBI to debar the Cardholder from holding the card, and cancel and withdraw the card, and the Cardholder shall also be liable for action under the Foreign Exchange Management Act,1999, Prevention of Money-Laundering Act, 2002 and any other Law and/or regulation in force from time to time, relating to the regulation of foreign exchange.

title: Forex Plus Card - restriction on domestic foreign currency transactions
text: ForexPlus Card cannot be used for making payment towards foreign currency transactions in India, Nepal and Bhutan i.e., while using the card in Nepal and Bhutan, the currency of the transactions should be the local currency of those countries or in Indian Rupees.

title: Forex Plus Card - no liability for cancelled card usage
text: In case the card is cancelled, whether on account of non-compliance with Exchange Control Regulation or otherwise, the Bank will not be responsible for any attempted usage of the card, whether in India or abroad, resulting in the card being dishonoured and the concerned Merchant would be entitled to pick up a cancelled card on presentation.

title: Forex Plus Card - usage within foreign entitlements
text: ForexPlus Card may be used within the foreign entitlements as stipulated by RBI from time to time, by Cardholders going abroad for all bonafide personal expenses provided, the total exchange drawn during the trip abroad does not exceed the entitlement. Import of goods so purchased abroad into India, would be governed by the baggage rules/EXIM policy in force at the relevant time. The entitlement of exchange should be ascertained (prior to the trip) from the authorised dealer branches of the Bank. The card cannot be used for effecting remittances, for which the release of exchange is not permissible under the extant regulations. Bank does not permit any payments /transactions using the card on Merchants registered in India, Nepal and Bhutan.

title: Forex Plus Card - cardholder responsibility for law compliance
text: The Cardholder shall be solely responsible to the concerned authorities in event of any violation of the applicable laws, rules and regulations in force from time to time. The Bank will not be liable for any direct, indirect or consequential loss or damage, arising from or related to the non-compliance by Cardholder with the applicable laws, rules and regulations in force from time to time.

title: Forex Plus Card - indemnity for non-compliance
text: The Cardholder hereby indemnifies and agrees to hold the Bank indemnified against all actions, claims and costs, charges and expenses arising out of or as a consequence of the Cardholder not complying with the applicable laws, rules and regulations in force from time to time.

title: Forex Plus Card - no liability for dishonoured cancelled card
text: In case the Card is cancelled (or its use suspended, whether on account of non-compliance with the applicable laws, rules and regulations in force from time to time or otherwise) the Bank will not be responsible for any use/attempted use of the Card, resulting in the Card being dishonoured or otherwise. The risk of dishonouring of a Card that is cancelled (and/or suspended) on its presentment is of such person and/or of the Cardholder in their individual capacity.

title: Forex Plus Card - notification of law changes
text: If there are changes in laws, rules or regulations affecting the relationship between the Bank and the Cardholder, the Bank shall notify the Cardholder of any such change by displaying it on the Bank's website and such display shall be deemed to be valid notice to the Cardholder of the amended laws, rules or regulations.

title: Forex Plus Card - validity outside India Nepal and Bhutan
text: ForexPlus Card is valid outside India, Nepal and Bhutan. The Card however shall not be valid for payments to Merchants registered in India, Nepal and Bhutan.

title: Forex Plus Card - card expiry and destruction
text: The card is valid up to the last day of the month in the year of expiry of the card, which is indicated on the card. Upon expiry of the Card, the Cardholder shall destroy the card by cutting it in half diagonally through the magnetic strip and chip. The card is not renewable. Customer to apply for new card.

title: Forex Plus Card - acceptance at ATMs and merchant establishments
text: The card is acceptable at any banks ATM which are members of Network Partner's (VISA/MasterCard), ATM network abroad and any Merchant Establishment outlet abroad.

title: Forex Plus Card - card acceptance responsibility
text: The acceptance of the VISA/MasterCard card is guided by Network Partner's (VISA/MasterCard) and information about the same is available on its website. Cardholders are expected to check the acceptance of the HDFC Bank ForexPlus Card in the Countries/Cities where they wish to use the Card. The Bank is not responsible for acceptance/non-acceptance of the HDFC Bank ForexPlus Card at a merchant establishment or an ATM in any country.

title: Forex Plus Card - prohibition on unauthorised usage
text: Use of the Card at any unauthorised location or for any purpose, other than as stated under these Terms and Conditions is strictly prohibited and may result in consequences, including but not limited to cancellation of the Card by the Bank.

title: Forex Plus Card - bank discretion on currency wallets
text: ForexPlus Card will carry the currency wallets in the card as prescribed in the features. However, the bank reserves the right, at its sole discretion, to increase or decrease the number of currencies available, without issuing any prior notice.

title: Forex Plus Card - option to load value on card
text: The Cardholder, or any other person duly authorised, shall have the option, to load value on the Card.

title: Forex Plus Card - name matching requirement for loading
text: The name of the funding account holder and the ForexPlus Card applicant should be same. In case of name mismatch, the load/reload request will be rejected, and the funds will be reversed back to the account of the Cardholder in two (2) working days.

title: Forex Plus Card - loading and reloading of foreign exchange
text: The Card may be loaded and/or reloaded with foreign exchange during its validity period by the Cardholder, or any other person duly authorised, giving a load instruction in the format as required by the Bank from time to time.

title: Forex Plus Card - instructions final and binding
text: Instructions once given shall be final and binding on the Cardholder and the Cardholder shall not be entitled to cancel or modify the same without the consent of the Bank. Without prejudice to the above, any loss arising out of any cancellation or modification of instructions shall be borne by the Cardholder.

title: Forex Plus Card - prepaid netbanking facility issuance
text: At the time of issuance of the ForexPlus Card, the Cardholder shall also be issued with the IPIN through which the Cardholder shall be entitled to access the PrepaidCard NetBanking Portal services offered in relation to the Card for all its future transactions.

title: Forex Plus Card - wallet to wallet balance transfer
text: The Cardholder shall also be entitled to transfer balances lying in one Currency Wallet to another Currency Wallet through PrepaidCard NetBanking, at the applicable currency exchange rate as determined by the Bank and communicated at the time of such transfer of balances. The intent/motive of performing the online wallet-to-wallet transfer should be strictly towards the requirement of the Cardholder to transact in the respective country for performing Point of Sale (POS)/ATM Cash Withdrawal/ E-commerce transactions for personal consumption during the international trip only.

title: Forex Plus Card - blocking for speculative gains
text: The Bank reserves right to block the Card permanently in the event of any wallet-to wallet transaction performed by the Cardholder towards the intent of making speculative gains and take the advantage of having maximum forex exchange gain and recover any such gains made by Cardholder by debiting the Card.

title: Forex Plus Card - ATM PIN customization
text: Through the PrepaidCard NetBanking service, the Cardholder shall also be entitled to customize ATM PIN that will be required for the Cardholder to access any Bank's ATM (international), which are members of the VISA/PLUS/MasterCard ATM network.

title: Forex Plus Card - cardholder responsibility for PIN safekeeping
text: It is clarified the Cardholder shall be solely responsible for the modification and safekeeping of the ATM PIN/IPIN.

title: Forex Plus Card - electronic facilities and communication risks
text: The Cardholder understands that any electronic facilities that are being provided are solely for the convenience of the Cardholder. The Cardholder agrees and acknowledges that communication through such electronic modes is subject to interference or modification by result of unauthorised access by third parties and/or loss or modification of communication due to errors in transmission. It is clarified that the Bank shall be entitled to rely on any such communication duly received, and to act upon the same without being required or expected to carry out an independent verification as to the authenticity, validity or correctness of such communication

title: Forex Plus Card - safe custody and PIN confidentiality
text: The Cardholder shall always ensure that the card is kept at a safe place, and that the ATM PIN/IPIN issued by the Bank at the time of issue of the Card are kept secret. The Cardholder shall under no circumstance whatsoever allow the card to be used by any other individual. The Cardholder will sign on the reverse of the card immediately upon receipt.

title: Forex Plus Card - no liability for third party misuse despite security measures
text: Notwithstanding any security measures that may be implemented by the Bank in respect of the Card, the Bank shall not be responsible for any misuse of the Card by any third person, including by reason of the Cardholder disclosing the activation code or ATM PIN/ IPIN to such person.

title: Forex Plus Card - PIN responsibility and bank liability
text: Personal Identification Number (PIN): The Bank will allot to the Cardholder a PIN to be used for cash withdrawals and balance enquiry at ATMs. The Cardholder shall be entitled, using the PrepaidCard NetBanking facilities, in accordance with the provisions herein, to change the ATM PIN. The Cardholder shall be responsible to maintain the confidentiality of the ATM PIN/IPIN. The Bank bears no liability for unauthorized use of the card.

title: Forex Plus Card - cardholder responsibility for all charges
text: The Cardholder will be responsible for all facilities granted by the Bank in respect of the card and for all related charges for use of the card.

title: Forex Plus Card - dispute resolution timeline
text: In case, the Cardholder has any dispute in respect to any charge indicated in the Statement, the Cardholder shall advice details to the Bank within 30 days of the Statement Date, failing which, it will be construed that all charges are acceptable and in order. The Bank may not at its sole discretion accept any disputes on charges older than 30 days.

title: Forex Plus Card - recovery of dues from card balance
text: Any amount due and payable by the Cardholder and/or the Corporate/Enterprise to the Bank, if not paid separately, shall be recovered by the Bank from the balance available on the ForexPlus card and/or debit the amounts due from any account held by the Cardholder with HDFC Bank.

title: Forex Plus Card - non-transferability
text: The Card is not transferable or non-assignable to any other person by the Cardholder under any circumstances.

title: Forex Plus Card - restriction on multiple cards of same currency
text: Purchase of multiple cards of the same currency is not permitted.

title: Forex Plus Card - no interest and no credit facility
text: The Cardholder is not entitled to earn any interest in connection with the loaded Funds in the ForexPlus card/ wallet and these funds do not constitute a deposit by the Cardholder with HDFC Bank. The Card does not entitle the Cardholder to any Overdraft / Credit Facility.

title: Forex Plus Card - prohibition on illegal purchases
text: You undertake and agree not to use the Card for making payment for any illegal purposes or purchases i.e. purchase of items / services not permitted by the RBI as per Foreign Exchange Regulations.

title: Forex Plus Card - repatriation of unspent foreign exchange
text: The unspent/unused foreign exchange shall be repatriated and surrendered by the Cardholder to the Bank within a period of 180 days from the date of such receipt/realisation/ purchase/ acquisition or date of return to India, as the case may be, in accordance with Foreign Exchange Management (Realisation, repatriation and surrender of foreign exchange) Regulations, 2015.

title: Forex Plus Card - redemption of unutilized balance
text: The Bank shall redeem the unutilized balance outstanding in the cards immediately upon request by the Cardholder to whom the cards are issued subject to retention of certain sums in accordance with the applicable RBI directions.

title: Forex Plus Card - reporting of lost or stolen cards
text: The Cardholder should inform the Bank at the Bank's Customer Care Centre immediately, if the Cardholder believes that the Card has been lost or stolen or misused.

title: Forex Plus Card - hotlisting and liability for unauthorized transactions
text:
If a card is lost or stolen or misused, the Cardholder must immediately hotlist the card either through the Prepaid Card NetBanking access provided or by calling toll-free numbers (click here) provided or Customer can visit nearest branch. In the event of any unauthorised transactions being made on the Card after such Card has been lost or stolen, the Cardholder should also file a report with the local police and send a copy forth with thereafter to the Bank. The Cardholder will be liable for all the charges incurred on the card until the card is hot-listed.

In case of an unsigned card, the Cardholder will be liable for all charges incurred on it. The Bank upon adequate verification will permanently suspend the card and will not be liable for any inconvenience caused to the Cardholder on this account. The Bank will hotlist/cancel the card immediately on the receipt of such intimation.

title: Forex Plus Card - emergency cash assistance overseas
text: If the Cardholder loses his card overseas and needs emergency cash, the Cardholder may call on 24*7 phone banking numbers (click here) for further assistance. The Cardholder will have to bear all costs related to currency conversion at all stages during the transaction.

title: Forex Plus Card - destruction of found lost card
text: The Cardholder shall take cognizance of the fact that once a card is reported lost, stolen or damaged and is subsequently found, the same shall be promptly cut in half across the magstripe and Chip, returned to the Bank and adequate care taken to prevent its misuse.

title: Forex Plus Card - cardholder responsibility for card security
text: The Cardholder is responsible for the security of the ForexPlus Card and shall take all steps towards ensuring the safe keeping thereof. In the event, the Bank determines that the aforementioned steps are questionable, financial liability on the lost or stolen card would rest with the Cardholder.

title: Forex Plus Card - replacement card issuance
text: Replacement card may be issued by the Bank, provided that the Cardholder has in all respects complied with the Terms and Conditions pertaining to the same.

title: Forex Plus Card - ATM PIN confidentiality
text: ForexPlus Card is operable with the help of a confidential ATM PIN at ATM locations. The ATM PIN should never be disclosed to any person or written down where any other person may discover it. Any such disclosure or inadequate protection of the confidentiality of the ATM PIN is entirely at the Cardholder's risk. All transactions conducted with use of the ATM PIN will be the Cardholder's responsibility and he will abide by the record of the transaction as generated.

title: Forex Plus Card - ATM network usage and complaints
text: ForexPlus Card is acceptable at any ATM which is part of networks (VISA/PLUS/MasterCard) belonging to institutions abroad. The Bank will not accept responsibility for any dealings the Cardholder may have with the other institutions including but not limited to such services. Should the Cardholder have any complaints concerning any VISA/PLUS/MasterCard ATM network establishment, the matter should be resolved by the Cardholder, and the establishment and failure to do so will not relieve him from any obligations to the Bank. However, the Cardholder should notify the Bank of this complaint immediately.

title: Forex Plus Card - service charges and denial of transactions
text: There will be separate service charges levied for facilities that will be announced by the Bank from time to time, and such charges may be deducted by the Bank from the balances available on the Card. In a situation where the Card does not have sufficient funds to deduct such service charges, the Bank reserves the right to deny such transactions and the decision of the Bank shall be binding on the Cardholder. The Bank shall not be liable for any consequences arising out of denial of transactions. The Bank shall have the right to set-off and lien, irrespective of any other lien or charge, present or future value of all balances held in the Card or in any Currency Wallet thereto, to the extent of all outstanding dues, whatsoever, arising as a result of the services extended by the Bank.

title: Forex Plus Card - no liability for ATM/POS malfunction
text: HDFC Bank will not be liable for any failure to provide any service or to perform any obligation thereof, under where such failure is attributable (whether directly or indirectly) to any malfunction of the ATM / POS machine/ Payment Gateway/Online portal or the Card temporarily, insufficiency of funds, any dispute or other circumstance beyond its control.

title: Forex Plus Card - recovery of excess debits
text: In case of debits in excess of funds held by the Cardholder, the Cardholder permits the Bank to debit his accounts(s) held with the Bank and / or reimburse the Bank funds towards such excess utilization subsequently on return, in case he does not have any operating account with the Bank.

title: Forex Plus Card - no liability for loss from card issue
text: Bank will not be liable for any consequential or indirect loss or damage arising from or related to the loss / issue of the Card and related PIN, howsoever caused.

title: Forex Plus Card - ATM service availability in other countries
text: The availability of ATM services in a country other than that in which the Card was issued is governed by the local regulations in force in the said country. Bank shall not be liable if these services are withdrawn without notice thereof.

title: Forex Plus Card - additional ATM fees by overseas banks
text: Few International ATMs may charge an additional fee on withdrawals. This fee is over and above the ATM withdrawal fee charged by HDFC Bank. This fee may appear with different terminology depending on the overseas bank for e.g. ATM Access Fee, ATM Ownership Fee.

title: Forex Plus Card - no responsibility for overseas ATM fees
text: HDFC Bank is not responsible for any such fees and will not be able to refund the same in case they are levied on account of usage of the card.

title: Forex Plus Card - alert communications to cardholder
text: The Bank may elect to send alerts to the Cardholders in relation to the use/holding of the Card from time to time, using any modes as it may deem fit, including but not limited to E-mail and/or SMS modes. For the purpose of sending such alerts, the Bank shall be entitled to rely on any information provided by the Cardholder in the application form or in any writing thereafter. The Bank may modify or withdraw such alerts facility at any time as it may deem fit.

title: Forex Plus Card - bank not liable for missed alerts
text: In the event there is any change in your Email ID and / or your mobile number, you need to get the same updated in bank records through Prepaid Card NetBanking or by giving a request in writing about such modification(s) to HDFC Bank branches. HDFC Bank shall not be liable for any loss, damage or inconvenience caused to you in case you do not receive such alert(s) due to any technical reasons at your end or at the respective telecom operator end or for any reason not within the reasonable control of the Bank.

title: Forex Plus Card - acceptance at merchant establishments abroad
text: ForexPlus Card is acceptable at all electronic Merchant Establishments abroad which display the Network Partner's (VISA/MasterCard) logo.

title: Forex Plus Card - electronic use only restriction
text: The card is meant for electronic use only and will be acceptable only at Merchant Establishments that have an EDC terminal, or are honouring the card for online payments through an acceptable payment gateway. The card is acceptable/operable with the help of the Cardholder's signature/ATM PIN at EDC terminals, installed at Merchant Establishments, or with the use of the Card on the relevant websites. Any usage of the card other than electronic use will be considered as unauthorised and the Cardholder will be solely responsible for such transactions. For the purposes of this Paragraph 4, "Electronic usage" shall be construed as transactions processed by the Merchant in online mode and where the charge slip/transaction slip is printed electronically from the EDC terminal, or payments made online through a payment gateway acceptable to the Bank.
